newsitem.title: USA: New York attorney general warns National Propane.
newsitem.headline: New York attorney general warns National Propane.

text.p: New York Attorney General Dennis Vacco said Thursday he has sent a notice to National Propane Corp that he plans to sue the Cedar Rapids, Iowa company unless it corrects its billing practices.

Vacco said he has given the company five days to respond to his allegation that it has improperly taken potentially tens of thousands of dollars in fees from customers. He wants the firm enter into a legal agreement to refund customers.
The agreement would also force the company to stop collecting fees that were not spelled out in written contracts with customers, or communicated to customers with verbal contracts.
The proposed settlement would give National Propane 30 days to pay refunds for alleged improper fees imposed since 1994.
Vacco said the firm provides propane service to thousands of Long Island customers, many of whom are senior citizens.
